local_clearance_change_basis: replace former uniform 0.50mm opening allowance with a local 0.30mm minimum plus explicit tolerance budget; same native component courtyard, same open cable exit; no PCB courtyard or DRC changes
tolerance_status: fabrication and incoming-acceptance REQUIREMENTS, not manufacturer guarantees or measurements. The KIPP D1=1.5mm is nominal without tolerance; every pin must fit the maximum diameter gauge.
sleeve_overhang: allowed above F face: sleeve end >=0.2mm above board; entire POM pin envelope remains on board
contact_patch: not inferred from pin diameter; actual tip profile/contact stress/abrasion remain physical checks
remaining: pressure-plate load path/deflection around revised notch
